--batch-per-host.Name: --batch-per-host
--batch-per-host.description: Max parallel batch reqs per host (default 6)

--blacklist-ip.Name: --blacklist-ip
--blacklist-ip.description: Blacklist an ip range from being called

--block-hostnames.Name: --block-hostnames
--block-hostnames.description: Block a case-insensitive hostname pattern, with optional leading wildcard, from being called

--console-output.Name: --console-output
--console-output.description: Redirects the console logging to the provided output file

--discard-response-bodies.Name: --discard-response-bodies
--discard-response-bodies.description: Read but don't process or save HTTP response bodies

--http-debug.Name: --http-debug
--http-debug.description: Log all HTTP requests and responses. Excludes body by default. To include body use '--http-debug=full'

--include-system-env-vars.Name: --include-system-env-vars
--include-system-env-vars.description: Pass the real system environment variables to the runtime (default true)

--iterations.Name: --iterations
--iterations.description: Script total iteration limit (among all VUs)

--linger.Name: --linger
--linger.description: Keep the API server alive past test end

--local-ips.Name: --local-ips
--local-ips.description: Client IP Ranges and/or CIDRs from which each VU will be making requests, e.g. '192.168.220.1,192.168.0.10-192.168.0.25', 'fd:1::0/120', etc

--min-iteration-duration.Name: --min-iteration-duration
--min-iteration-duration.description: Minimum amount of time k6 will take executing a single iteration

--no-summary.Name: --no-summary
--no-summary.description: Don't show the summary at the end of the test

--no-usage-report.Name: --no-usage-report
--no-usage-report.description: Don't send anonymous stats to the developers

--out.Name: --out
--out.description: Uri for an external metrics database

--paused.Name: --paused
--paused.description: Start the test in a paused state

--summary-export.Name: --summary-export
--summary-export.description: Output the end-of-test summary report to JSON file

--summary-time-unit.Name: --summary-time-unit
--summary-time-unit.description: Define the time unit used to display the trend stats. Possible units are: 's', 'ms' and 'us'

--summary-trend-stats.Name: --summary-trend-stats
--summary-trend-stats.description: Define stats for trend metrics (response times), one or more as 'avg,p(95),...' (default 'avg,min,med,max,p(90),p(95)')

--system-tags.Name: --system-tags
--system-tags.description: Only include these system tags in metrics (default "proto,subproto,status,method,url,name,group,check,error,error_code,tls_version,scenario,service,expected_response")

--tag.description: Add a tag to be applied to all samples, as `[name]=[value]`
